blocks.text: Hot Tub Removal in the GTA — Fully Handled From Start to Finish

c: Old hot tubs and spas are one of the heaviest and most awkward items to remove from a property. They are often built into decks, surrounded by fencing, or locked in backyards with no easy access. Live Junk Free removes hot tubs and spas of all sizes across the Greater Toronto Area — we handle the full job including disconnection, demolition where needed, hauling, and responsible disposal. You do not lift a finger.

We remove portable hot tubs, in-ground spas, jacuzzis, and swim spas. Whether yours is on a deck, a patio, or at the back of a narrow yard — we have the equipment and the crew to get it out safely and efficiently.

blocks.text: Frequently Asked Questions About Hot Tube Removal in the GTA

items.q: How much does hot tub removal cost?
a: Hot tub removal starts from $99. The final price depends on the size of the unit, the access route, and whether demolition is needed. All prices are confirmed upfront before any work begins.

items.q: Do you disconnect the hot tub before removing it?
a: Yes. Our crew handles the full process including disconnecting power and plumbing connections before any removal work begins.

items.q: Can you remove a hot tub from a fenced backyard?
a: Yes. We deal with tricky access regularly. Let us know the situation when you book and we will bring the right equipment.

items.q: How fast can you remove my hot tub?
a: Same-day removal is available across most of the GTA when you book before 12pm. Call 647-922-5865 to check availability in your area.

items.q: Do you also remove jacuzzis and swim spas?
a: Yes. We remove hot tubs, jacuzzis, portable spas, and swim spas of all sizes.

items.q: Are you insured for hot tub removal?
a: Yes. Fully licensed and insured on every job. Proof of coverage available on request.
